recorded.prompt:q-kept-mux-after-edit: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-kept-mux-after-edit: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-kept-mux-after-edit: 1.5.1 shows the cached mux returning 'null after 5000 ms' after the touch: Q2 stopped the old multiplexer, which no longer reads host-receive, and the new one put the reply on host-unhandled.
recorded.prompt:q-console-before-masking: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-console-before-masking: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-console-before-masking: 1.6 and the Summary say ProtectedLogListener masks the event only for the listeners after it; log/q2.log stayed masked while the console, placed before it, showed clear PANs.
recorded.prompt:q-dead-link-without-ready: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-dead-link-without-ready: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-dead-link-without-ready: 1.3's output shows that without <ready> and with the host refusing connections, isConnected is true and the request is 'null after 5000 ms' (the full timeout); 1.4 says request puts the message in host-send and it waits there until a connection attempt succeeds.
recorded.prompt:q-spring-constructor-lookup: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-spring-constructor-lookup: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-spring-constructor-lookup: 1.5.2 says Spring starts lifecycle beans such as EmbeddedQ2 only after it has created every ordinary bean, so the constructor threw 'NotFoundException: mux.host-mux' and the context failed.

recorded.outcome:q-kept-mux-after-edit:c: 1.5.1 shows 'cached mux, after: null after 5000 ms' and 'same object? false', which refutes both the outcome and the reason.
recorded.prompt:q-kept-mux-after-edit:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-kept-mux-after-edit:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-kept-mux-after-edit:d: 1.5.1 says 'a stopped multiplexer no longer reads host-receive', and the cached mux returned null.
recorded.prompt:q-console-before-masking:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-console-before-masking:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-console-before-masking:b: 1.6 ties masking to listener order, not listener kind (the file is masked 'because its listener still comes after the masking one'), so the reason is refuted, although the outcome matches the correct one.
recorded.prompt:q-console-before-masking:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-console-before-masking:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-console-before-masking:c: 1.6 shows the console listener placed before the masking one printing the clear PAN, refuting the outcome, and the Summary says masking protects only the listeners after it, refuting the reason.
recorded.prompt:q-console-before-masking:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-console-before-masking:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)

recorded.outcome:q-dead-link-without-ready:b: 1.4 says the message sits in host-send with the timeout as its lifetime and waits, and the 1.3 output shows null after 5000 ms, not at once.
recorded.prompt:q-dead-link-without-ready:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
